# Awesome Claude Plugins & Engineering Guide

This skill guides the agent on how to leverage the curated directory of top 100 AI plugins and best-practice frameworks located in `awesome-claude-plugins/`.

## When to Use
- Whenever starting a new task, project, feature, or refactoring in this workspace.
- When the user asks for best quality, production-grade solutions, clean architecture, or advanced UI/UX.
- When searching for specialized open-source tools (crypto with CCXT, browser automation, testing, documentation, diagrams).

## Key Standards from Top Repositories

### 1. Planning & Software Methodology (`superpowers`, `planning-with-files`)
- Always make a clear, phased plan before writing code for complex features.
- Persist progress in a clear markdown checklist or notes.
- After each phase, test and verify before moving forward.

### 2. LLM Engineering Standards (`andrej-karpathy-skills`)
- Prevent common LLM traps: avoid hallucinatory assumptions, don't generate huge unverified boilerplate, always test small units first.
- Keep context lean and high-signal.

### 3. World-Class UI/UX (`ui-ux-pro-max-skill`, `impeccable`)
- Never produce generic or bland interfaces.
- Use tailored colors, dark mode defaults, modern sans-serif typography (e.g. Inter/Outfit), subtle shadows/borders, and engaging micro-interactions.

### 4. Specialized Tool Integration (`ccxt`, `agent-browser`, etc.)
- Use the local reference at `awesome-claude-plugins/README.md` to identify top libraries for specific domains.
- For Crypto tasks, use `ccxt` for accurate, unified exchange communication.
